mods.name: MusicWorld
mods.description: Procedural world generation driven by music genre profiles.

releases.notes:
## MusicWorld v6.0.0

Custom terrain generation for 7 music genres: metal, jazz, classical, hiphop, electronic, pop, ambient.

### What's in this release
- `musicworld-6.0.0.jar` — Fabric mod (put in your `mods/` folder)
- `musicworld-datapack-v7.zip` — Datapack (put in `world/datapacks/`)

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader 0.16.10+
- Fabric API 0.92.7+1.20.1

### Setup
See the README for full instructions including CurseForge setup and Spotify integration.

readmeSummary: A Minecraft Fabric mod that generates custom terrain based on music genres. Run /genworld to switch the terrain style for newly generated chunks.
